exposure: Time of delivery (before vs during pandemic)
cohort: Women in labor with history of caesarean section who gave birth between March 2019 and December 2020 in a tertiary hospital in southern Spain
finding: The success rate of VBAC was lower during the pandemic, and factors associated with VBAC success were: birth before the pandemic, birth at night, use of epidural analgesia, and having had a previous vaginal birth.
